verdict: MIXED (see payload — honest negatives are findings)
reading_one: ROPESIGHT HOLDS: blinded lanes (own token copy + own position + own counter [+ own memorised line in the line rule]) complete every method and every called touch byte-identically to the global-sight run — and the conductor's audit sheet is not load-bearing (zero-sheet run, same hash).
reading_two: UNILATERAL DEVIATION IS LOCALLY DETECTABLE AT LATENCY 0, FALSE ALARMS 0: the slot partition makes any lone wrong transposition land in someone else's slot in the SAME stroke, and the displaced honest lane receives its clash bit then. But the deviator's OWN expected-next-position check fires only when its physical move exceeds one place (measured partition, not the kind label) — a near deviation that cancels or shortens its move is rope-silent to its owner and visible ONLY through the partner's clash bit. Local detection is channel-based (slot contention), not position-based.
reading_three: RECOVERY NEEDS THE PRACTICED LINE: under the line rule (ringer re-finds their place by their own count) every stumble heals byte-identically; under method-pos (no personal schedule) the deviator keeps ringing the method from the wrong place and the wrongness persists (persistFraction + clash density receipted). The blue line is what makes recovery possible — "the practice is what keeps it from happening" (L81).
reading_four: A lost lane hunting legally never trips its own rope (legal moves, wrong places — "a moving weight with an opinion", L21); it is caught only by recurring clash density and by the course never returning to rounds (0/920 closed).
reading_five: THE TUNNEL IS REAL: at the trade stroke a coordinated pair-trade is invisible on EVERY sample — no clash (the claim set is unchanged), no signal in uninvolved lanes, the row is valid but wrong. Under the line rule the pair rejoins its lines and the course heals byte-identically — undetectable by ANY local channel and by the rounds check; only the conductor's global audit (or a chain replay) sees it. Under method-pos the tunnel collapses behind them (post-trade clash density receipted) — but each honest lane still sees only its own bits.
